patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports a skin lesion on her right leg that has been present for 1 month. The lesion began as a small red spot and has increased in size. She recalls an ant bite at the site before the lesion developed. She has a history of anterior uveitis treated with corticosteroids 8 months ago, as well as Crohn's disease, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypertension.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Painful ulcerative lesion on the right leg
Secondary_Symptoms: Lesion has a central necrotic base and purplish irregular borders
History of ant bite at the site of the lesion
Pitting pedal edema of the lower extremities
Dilated tortuous veins in both lower legs

Past_Medical_History: Treated for anterior uveitis 8 months ago
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Recently returned from a visit to Wisconsin 2 months ago.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with a painful, ulcerative skin lesion on her leg.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “About a month ago I noticed a small red spot on my right leg after what I thought was an ant bite, and it’s grown into a painful ulcer with a central necrotic area and purplish irregular borders. I’ve also noticed swelling in my lower legs with pitting pedal edema and dilated, tortuous veins on both sides.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin excoriations—like small scratches, open sore areas, or areas where the skin looks rubbed raw—anywhere on your body? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “Yes—there have been some small rubbed-raw areas around the ulcer on my right leg, but I haven’t noticed any significant open sores or excoriations elsewhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever been told that you stop breathing during sleep, or have you noticed episodes where you briefly stop breathing and then gasp or wake up? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been told that I stop breathing during sleep, and I haven’t noticed any episodes where I briefly stop breathing and then gasp or wake up.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury or fall, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—like severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—there wasn’t a fall or injury besides the presumed insect bite, and I haven’t had severe swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using my right leg beyond the pain from the ulcer.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist**? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No— I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, new discoloration or marks on the skin of your chest)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new bruising or discoloration on my chest wall. I’ve mainly had the ulcer on my right leg and the swelling with the visible veins in both lower legs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been urinating more than usual or producing a larger amount of urine lately. My main issue has been the painful ulcer on my right leg and the swelling in my lower legs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco/nicotine, cannabis, opioids (including prescription pain pills), stimulants, or other drugs?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t use tobacco or nicotine, cannabis, or opioids, and I haven’t been using stimulants or other drugs. I do not drink alcohol regularly either.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or needing to rush to the bathroom and not making it in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had trouble controlling my urine—no leaking and no sudden urgency or accidents. My urinary habits have been normal, aside from the ongoing leg swelling and the ulcer pain.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin lesion (such as a new spot, sore, mole, or patch) anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, besides the right leg ulcer that started as a small red spot after an ant bite and has enlarged over the past month, I haven’t noticed any other new or changing skin lesions anywhere else on my body.”
